judgement.reason: The Go build stage reads TARGETARCH, which has no default, and exits if it is empty; it is unproven that the Deployz build sets it automatically, as BuildKit does, when no build arguments are passed.

evidence.quote: RUN case "${TARGETARCH}" in amd64) GOARCH=amd64 ;; arm64) GOARCH=arm64 ;; *) echo "Unsupported arch: ${TARGETARCH}" && exit 1 ;; esac && \
